descripcion: Legal ruling by Loys de Camañas, judge of Teruel, on March 3, 1460, concerning a hunting dispute involving Joán de la Mata and Daniel de la Mata against Pascual Valero and Marco Miguel over hunting rights in a defended area (deffesa) in Cañadín. The ruling upholds the Mata brothers' rights based on a privilege granted to their grandmother, Benedita la Mata, and confirmed by King Pedro. Valero and Miguel are ordered to comply and are fined for non-compliance.

He details his qualifications, including being a 23-year-old single man from Villa del Prado, a certified professor from the Normal and Elemental School (having received a superior grade), and having eight months of teaching experience in Val de Santo Domingo. He mentions the support of the local board and parents who entrusted him with their children's education.
